execution.required_next_work: Main-owned NEW95 focused digital verification after independent source review
execution.result_statement: Every vector is a future source-contract stimulation and observation plan only.

test_boundary.public_stimulus: AXI4-Lite ports plus the BUILD_ID parameter only
test_boundary.no_bypass: No hierarchical force, stub encoder, injected fake successful RX byte, regenerated packet, or CRC repair
test_boundary.byte_oracle: A future runner must independently decode observed core UART TX bytes and compare them with repeated non-destructive FIFO peek plus explicit POP results
test_boundary.wire_byte_formula: A successful result requires RX_total_after = RX_total_before + actual trace_result_bytes; the unchanged existing source reports 14 + payload_meta_bytes
test_boundary.unreachable_branches: Normal one-scan/empty-FIFO policy cannot naturally fill 4096 bytes or exhaust 32-bit counters; those defensive branches require separate main review and must not be described as dynamic coverage
non_claims: No board, physical UART, analog ADC, calibration, Root/BOOT authentication, motion authorization, timing closure, H12 completion, or product acceptance

common_fixture_values.quality_note: 0x1 valid, 0x5 held+valid, 0x0 invalid, 0x9 source_fault+valid; a valid held sample requires source_qpc_ns < acquisition_qpc_ns

vectors.area: reset identity and stopped state
preconditions: Assert reset, then release and allow the two-cycle synchronous release.
actions: Read 0x000-0x018 and the status/counter/flag registers.
source_contract_expectation: Magic 0x54353046, layout 1, kind 4, clock 50000000, baud 1000000, FIFO 4096.
State is 0/CANCEL, faults/flags/counters are zero, FIFO empty, source_cancel asserted, profile/transport gates low.

vectors.area: BUILD_ID zero disables ARM
preconditions: Default BUILD_ID=0; stage nonzero tag and valid uint63 origin.
actions: Issue command 1.
source_contract_expectation: B=SLVERR, state remains CANCEL, no rearm or UART traffic.
ARM staging remains fresh because a refused known command does not consume it.

vectors.area: ARM staging and uint63 origin rejection
preconditions: Use nonzero BUILD_ID.
actions: Omit one of 0x100/0x104/0x108 and ARM.
Rewrite all three, set 0x108=0x80000000 and ARM.
Clear bit31, set tag 0 and ARM.
source_contract_expectation: Each attempt returns SLVERR and remains CANCEL.
Reserved origin bit31 and zero tag cause no source_cancel release or rearm.

vectors.area: greater-tag rule and retention
preconditions: Complete one ARM/CANCEL sequence with tag N; FIFO empty and core quiescent.
actions: ARM tag N, then tag 0, then tag N+1.
source_contract_expectation: Equal and lower tags return SLVERR; N+1 is accepted.
last_arm_tag retains N+1 across CANCEL/CLEAR_FAULT until hardware reset.

vectors.area: ARM sequencing and one-cycle rearm
preconditions: Valid ARM staging and nonzero BUILD_ID; core quiescent and RX idle.
actions: ARM and observe acceptance, following cycle, and entry to ARMED.
source_contract_expectation: source_cancel is high through the accepting edge and drops afterward.
Exactly one capture_rearm pulse occurs after cancel deasserts; profile/transport stay low until ARMED.
Cancel and rearm never share an edge.

vectors.area: AW-before-W capture
preconditions: Stopped endpoint; legal RW staging write.
actions: Present AW alone and wait for AWREADY; delay W by at least two clocks.
source_contract_expectation: AW is retained while W is absent; the pair commits once after W arrives.
Staging readback shows one write only.

vectors.area: W-before-AW capture
preconditions: Stopped endpoint; legal RW staging write.
actions: Present W alone and wait for WREADY; then present AW.
source_contract_expectation: W is retained while AW is absent; the pair commits once.
No effect occurs merely because W was accepted first.

vectors.area: BREADY stall does not repeat commands
preconditions: Prepare a one-shot PUSH or ACK.
actions: Hold BREADY low for several clocks after AW/W acceptance.
Observe target freshness/counter each cycle, then release BREADY.
source_contract_expectation: BRESP/BVALID remain stable.
The target effect occurs once at write_accept and is not replayed under B stall.
A second command cannot enter the occupied response slot.

vectors.area: RREADY stall holds read response
preconditions: A legal read address with known captured value.
actions: Issue AR; hold RREADY low while unrelated state changes; release RREADY.
source_contract_expectation: RVALID/RDATA/RRESP captured for that AR remain stable.
The read changes no FIFO, counter, freshness, or result state.

vectors.area: invalid writes have no endpoint mutation
preconditions: Snapshot state, faults, counters, FIFO count, and staging readbacks.
actions: Write an RO offset with full strobe.
Write a legal stage/command offset misaligned.
Use WSTRB missing bits 0 and 15.
Write an unknown offset.
Write a command with nonzero bits31:8.
source_contract_expectation: Every exercise returns SLVERR.
No staging, freshness, tag, FIFO, counter, result, fault, or state change comes from these writes.
Unknown command does not update last_cmd.

vectors.area: unknown and misaligned reads
preconditions: Known state and FIFO count.
actions: Read 0x080, 0x084, and a non-word-aligned aperture address.
source_contract_expectation: Each returns RDATA=0 and RRESP=SLVERR.
No FIFO or model state changes.

vectors.area: four-lane valid, held, invalid, and source-fault chain
preconditions: ARM accepted; raw data [-32768,-1,0,32767], qualities [0x1,0x5,0x0,0x9], one common uint63 tick.
actions: Stage and PUSH channels 0..3 in order, then inspect next channel and continue through BIND.
source_contract_expectation: All four lanes pass legal validation, preserving signed16 and byte value 0.
Invalid lane 2 uses data 0x0000.
Captured quality preserves valid/held/invalid/source_fault semantics and is not relabelled as measured health.

vectors.area: invalid padding and illegal quality
preconditions: ARMED with fresh sample staging.
actions: Invalid 0x0 with nonzero raw data.
Invalid with saturated bit 0x2.
Invalid with held bit 0x4.
Legal invalid zero with data 0.
source_contract_expectation: First three PUSH attempts return SLVERR and do not advance lane count.
The legal invalid-zero PUSH is accepted once.

vectors.area: channel, common tick, and fifth-lane bounds
preconditions: ARMED and expecting lane 1.
actions: PUSH channel 2, channel 0, then expected channel with a different tick.
Complete four legal lanes and issue a fifth PUSH.
source_contract_expectation: Wrong/out-of-order channel and differing tick return SLVERR without consuming staging.
Fifth PUSH is refused in CAPTURED.

vectors.area: sample reserved high bits
preconditions: ARMED.
actions: Set high bits in 0x110, 0x114, 0x11c, and 0x120 on separate attempts.
source_contract_expectation: Each PUSH returns SLVERR; no value is silently truncated.
Refused commands leave staging present for correction.

vectors.area: BIND staging completeness
preconditions: CAPTURED after four lanes.
actions: Omit each association field group and attempt BIND.
Rewrite all ten fields and BIND.
source_contract_expectation: Incomplete variants return SLVERR and remain CAPTURED.
The complete direct fixture descriptor enters BINDING once.

vectors.area: acquisition reconstruction and overflow
preconditions: CAPTURED at the common retained tick.
actions: Use wrong origin.
Use tick 1001 or remainder 124.
Set remainder 1000.
Force origin+tick*1000+remainder above uint63.
source_contract_expectation: Each defect returns SLVERR and presents no assoc_valid.
Only exact checked reconstruction matching the retained lane tick is accepted.

vectors.area: source reconstruction, ordering, and held flag
preconditions: CAPTURED with a valid association candidate.
actions: Make source QPC inconsistent with origin+tick*1000+rem.
Set source>acquisition.
Set source<acquisition with held=0.
Set held=1 when source equals acquisition.
source_contract_expectation: Each mismatch returns SLVERR and starts no core transaction.
Held is required exactly iff source<acquisition for a valid sample.

vectors.area: fixture frame identity and sequence ordering
preconditions: CAPTURED; all association fields fresh.
actions: Set epoch high bits or frame-seq high bits.
Repeat the prior frame seq within one ARM.
Use a decreasing seq, then a strictly increasing seq.
source_contract_expectation: Reserved high bits, equal/reused seq, and decreasing seq return SLVERR.
A strictly increasing low16 seq is accepted; a new can-clear/re-arm may start identity again, but it is still fixture-local.

vectors.area: BIND descriptor hold and cancel release
preconditions: CAPTURED and a legal association descriptor.
actions: BIND and hold AXI B/R traffic stalled while observing core descriptor inputs.
Exercise CANCEL before an eventual ready handshake in a separate run.
source_contract_expectation: assoc_valid and every descriptor field remain stable until actual assoc_ready or CANCEL.
CANCEL drops assoc_valid and no hidden timeout or retry starts.

vectors.area: exact successful wire-byte result and held visibility
preconditions: One association accepted; capture RX_total_before and actual core trace_result_bytes.
actions: Let actual encoder/UART TX/RX fill the raw FIFO.
Repeatedly read FIFO peek and independently decode observed UART TX bytes.
Check success only when RX idle and RX_total_after equals before+result_bytes.
Hold BREADY and RREADY low around result reads.
source_contract_expectation: The result becomes visible only at the exact total wire count, including header; payload-only counting is insufficient.
Result ID, error, bytes, start/end, and held data remain stable across stalls.
FIFO bytes preserve the actual wire stream without parser repair.

vectors.area: ACK exactness
preconditions: A visible result and actual core result_valid.
actions: Stage wrong, zero, and stale IDs.
Stage exact ID and ACK once.
Attempt duplicate ACK and a second exact pulse while WAIT_CORE_IDLE.
source_contract_expectation: Wrong/zero/stale ACK returns SLVERR without hiding the result or pulsing core ready.
Exact ACK permits one fixture_result_ready pulse and hides the visible result.
Duplicate ACK cannot advance state again or replay core consumption.

vectors.area: core-refused result with partial bytes
preconditions: Association accepted and a legal source shape that the unchanged core refuses.
actions: Wait for actual core result_error!=0 and RX idle.
Read result/error/refusal/start/end and retained FIFO bytes.
Try to describe it as a successful frame.
source_contract_expectation: The refused result is visible with the exact core error and last refusal code.
Actual partial RX bytes remain raw and result_rx_end records the observed total.
No success frame, byte padding, CRC repair, or result regeneration occurs.

vectors.area: excess and missing accepted wire bytes
preconditions: WAIT_RESULT with a successful-error core result and known before/result_bytes.
actions: In separate attempts stop RX idle short of the required total, then exceed the required total before result acceptance.
source_contract_expectation: Both cases latch sticky fault bits and enter CANCEL; no success result becomes visible.
No auto-ACK, replay, or packet completion is fabricated.

vectors.area: four acknowledgements then COMPLETE
preconditions: ARM with four lanes; complete result and exact ACK for channels 0..3.
actions: Observe each result id and state.
After the fourth ACK wait for result_valid deassert.
Attempt BIND and read status.
source_contract_expectation: Result IDs increase once per accepted result.
After the fourth ACK state is COMPLETE, status complete is set, and no automatic CANCEL/rearm or fifth scan occurs.
Raw FIFO remains until explicit POP/CLEAR_FIFO.

vectors.area: CANCEL at ARM_WAIT, ARM_SETTLE, and ARMED
preconditions: Fresh ARM then CANCEL at each distinct timing boundary in separate attempts.
actions: Observe source_cancel, gates, capture_rearm, state, and result_canceled.
source_contract_expectation: CANCEL is accepted, state returns CANCEL, source_cancel asserts, gates drop, and no rearm pulse is generated by CANCEL itself.
The partial arm never accepts a later PUSH without a fresh higher-tag ARM.

vectors.area: CANCEL during CAPTURED or stalled BINDING
preconditions: Four lanes captured; hold association before ready in one attempt.
actions: Issue CANCEL while assoc_valid is held.
Read freshness, state, result-canceled, and retained FIFO.
source_contract_expectation: CANCEL drops assoc_valid and profile/transport gates at the next state edge.
Held descriptor capability is invalidated; result_canceled indicates the partial transaction.
No implicit second scan or retry starts.

vectors.area: CANCEL during WAIT_RESULT with partial wire evidence
preconditions: Association accepted and at least one actual encoded byte observed.
actions: Assert CANCEL before core result completion.
Record observed UART bytes, RX aborted counter, FIFO count, RX_total, and result visibility.
source_contract_expectation: source_cancel aborts the actual path; in-flight partial UART byte accounting is visible through stat_aborted.
Accepted raw bytes remain in FIFO but are not labelled a completed packet or acknowledged result.
Canceled/partial outcome is recorded.

vectors.area: CANCEL with RESULT_READY and after COMPLETE
preconditions: Run A holds one visible result; run B completes four ACKs.
actions: CANCEL in each run and read result_visible, result_canceled, state, gates, and FIFO.
source_contract_expectation: Visible result capability is dropped and result_canceled records the explicit cancel.
COMPLETE does not auto-CANCEL; only command 5 or reset does.
FIFO and cumulative counters are retained.

vectors.area: sticky fault clearing is explicit and non-arm
preconditions: Cause a locally observable RX or core fault; then stop.
actions: Attempt CLEAR_FAULT while busy/nonquiescent.
Wait for core quiescence and RX idle, then CLEAR_FAULT.
Attempt immediate PUSH/BIND; then drain FIFO and stage a fresh greater ARM.
source_contract_expectation: Early clear returns SLVERR; no sticky bit is cleared.
Successful clear does not auto-ARM or reset IDs/FIFO/counters.
A fresh legal ARM is still required after drain.

vectors.area: non-destructive peek, byte zero, and explicit POP
preconditions: At least one actual raw byte is present, including a zero-valued byte where the real stream supplies it.
actions: Read 0x070 many times without issuing POP.
Stage exact pop id and POP once.
Read count, head, and pop id again.
source_contract_expectation: Peek never removes data; bit8 valid is independent from byte value 0x00.
POP removes one item once, decrements count, and increments pop_id exactly once.

vectors.area: empty, stale, duplicate, and overflow POP refusal
preconditions: Exercise empty FIFO; after one POP, retry stale expected ID and duplicate ID.
actions: Issue POP with missing freshness.
Issue correct empty POP.
Reuse consumed ID.
Stage expected pop_id 0xffffffff near the counter limit.
source_contract_expectation: All invalid cases return SLVERR and do not decrement, wrap, or replay.
Only expected==current+1 on nonempty FIFO succeeds.

vectors.area: explicit CLEAR_FIFO accounting
preconditions: CANCEL, quiescent, RX idle, nonzero FIFO, and no visible/core result.
actions: Read count, rx_total, pop_id, result_id, and discard_count.
Issue CLEAR_FIFO, then verify registers and attempt ARM with an empty FIFO.
source_contract_expectation: All retained bytes are counted into discard_count and FIFO count becomes zero.
rx_total, pop_id, result_id, and BUILD_ID are not reset.
CLEAR_FIFO is not implied by ARM and does not itself ARM.

vectors.area: FIFO full with simultaneous RX/POP defensive branch
preconditions: Main-authorized non-hierarchical capacity test only; normal public one-scan path cannot fill 4096 bytes.
actions: At count 4096, present one actual RX byte without POP; then with an eligible simultaneous POP.
source_contract_expectation: Without POP no byte is silently overwritten: overflow fault 0x00000002 latches and the path cancels.
With one eligible POP, one old item is removed and the new byte uses that capacity; count remains 4096.
Until a valid test mechanism exists this remains static-review scope, not claimed coverage.

vectors.area: 32-bit counter saturation defensive branch
preconditions: Main-authorized counter-boundary test only; thresholds are not naturally reachable.
actions: Exercise RX-total max, result-id max, pop-id max, and discard-sum overflow gates.
source_contract_expectation: RX/result/pop/discard counters fault or refuse before wrap; none increments from 0xffffffff to zero.
The state must not claim a new scan/result on saturation.

vectors.area: reset with pending bus or command state
preconditions: Capture AW without W, request R with RREADY low, and hold a command/result in separate attempts.
actions: Assert reset during each pending state, release, and observe outputs/state.
Do not supply any old valid payload again.
source_contract_expectation: Captured AW/W/B/R and command state clear; BVALID/RVALID state does not retain a phantom response.
Reset returns to CANCEL with source_cancel asserted and IDs/counters zero.
No old command, ACK, ARM, or packet replay occurs.

vectors.area: actual UART RX framing/overrun/false-start defensive observation
preconditions: A main-approved non-hierarchical source of a real physical-level-like fault is available; no fake success byte.
actions: Cause each actual receiver event while active.
Read sticky fault bits, state, RX aborted, gates, and FIFO.
source_contract_expectation: Any event latches its mapped bit and cancels; no partial frame becomes a visible successful result.
Without an actual fault source this remains source-review scope and is not claimed executed.

vectors.area: no hidden retry or second scan
preconditions: ARM/CANCEL and COMPLETE scenarios completed.
actions: Leave endpoint idle without new commands.
Attempt PUSH/BIND outside their state gates.
Then issue explicit fresh CANCEL, drain, higher-tag ARM.
source_contract_expectation: No idle cycle, stall release, result ACK, or fault clear auto-ARMs or retries.
Out-of-state PUSH/BIND returns SLVERR without consuming staging.
Only explicit legal sequencing begins another scan.

partial, misaligned, read-only, unknown, and reserved-bit writes
